title: Unit receivable advancement processed with failure
description: Outcome of a Tangara post-contracted advancement batch rejected during processing. Processing is all or nothing: the event mirrors the operations of the batch and attaches the errors to the advanced receivables that caused the failure. The event is strictly informative and nothing is applied to the unit receivables. One event is emitted per batch, correlated by the cid of the envelope. Produced by ur-api, the Tangara unit receivable service.
